subject: Chemical smell near the harbour after midnight
body: For the last three nights trucks from Nordvik Chemicals have been emptying something into the drain behind warehouse 7 at the harbour. It happens around 01:00. The smell is sharp, like solvent. I work night shifts nearby and have photos.

subject: Nordvik trucks dumping at warehouse 7?
body: Not sure who to tell. Saw two Nordvik Chemicals tankers at the back of warehouse 7 last night, hoses going into the storm drain. Dead fish in the inner harbour this morning.

subject: URGENT: school roof inspection report was falsified
body: I am an engineer at the municipality. The inspection report for the Østerby School gym roof was changed after I signed it. The original found critical corrosion in the load-bearing beams. The gym is still in daily use. Please contact me today, I can share both versions.

subject: Council member's new holiday home
body: Council member J. Holm voted for the new marina zoning in June. In August a company owned by his brother-in-law bought three plots next to the marina. Land registry numbers attached in my next message if you are interested.

subject: Bus line 12 always late
body: Line 12 has been late every single morning for a month. Nobody at the bus company answers complaints. Someone should write about this.

subject: Hospital waiting list numbers
body: The regional hospital reports 6 weeks average wait for hip surgery. Internally the figure is 19 weeks; patients who are 'awaiting pre-assessment' are left out of the public count. I work in administration and can confirm with documents, but I will lose my job if anyone finds out it was me.

subject: Re: harbour pollution
body: I wrote to you before about the harbour. It happened again tonight at warehouse 7. Same Nordvik trucks. I have video now.

subject: Great article about the library
body: Just wanted to say thanks for the piece on the library reopening. My kids love it. Keep it up!

subject: Tip about the marina deal - pre-approved
body:

subject: Stray cats at the allotment gardens
body: There are about twenty stray cats living at the allotment gardens on Kirkevej. Could be a nice local story.
